parameters.query: =SELECT t.code, t.name, t.sport, t.logo_key, t.entry_type, t.status, t.area, t.city, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, CASE WHEN t.status = 'LIVE' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' OR t.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS stage, (t.status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' AND (t.registration_deadline IS NULL OR t.registration_deadline >= CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+05:30'))) AS reg_open, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS teams, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('division', d.name, 'team', tm.name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key))  FROM tournament_matches fm JOIN tournament_entries we ON we.id = fm.winner_entry_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = we.team_id  JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = fm.division_id  WHERE fm.tournament_id = t.id AND fm.stage = 'KNOCKOUT' AND fm.status = 'COMPLETED'  AND fm.round_no = (SELECT MAX(x.round_no) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = fm.division_id AND x.stage = 'KNOCKOUT')  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = fm.division_id AND x.stage = 'KNOCKOUT' AND x.round_no = fm.round_no) = 1) AS champions, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 1, CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' divisions'), CASE MIN(v.format) WHEN 'LEAGUE' THEN 'League' WHEN 'KNOCKOUT' THEN 'Knockout' ELSE 'Groups + knockout' END)  FROM tournament_divisions v WHERE v.tournament_id = t.id) AS format_tag FROM tournaments t WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND COALESCE(t.kind, 'TOURNAMENT') <> 'QUICK' AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' AND ($1 = 'ALL' OR t.sport = $1) AND ($2 = 'ALL' OR ($2 = 'LIVE' AND t.status = 'LIVE')  OR ($2 = 'OPEN' AND t.status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN') OR ($2 = 'DONE' AND CASE WHEN t.status = 'LIVE' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' OR t.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 2 ELSE 1 END = 2)) ORDER BY stage, IF(CASE WHEN t.status = 'LIVE' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' OR t.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 2 ELSE 1 END = 2, -TO_DAYS(t.end_date), TO_DAYS(t.start_date)), t.id DESC LIMIT 21 OFFSET {{ $json.offset }}
